subject: executor: refactor the `BaseExecutor` and remove session context in `ProjectionExec` (#54614)
summary: Diff vs first parent updates `ProjectionExec` to embed `exec.BaseExecutorV2` and to cache statement/expression execution inputs (stmt mem tracker, runtime stats collection, eval ctx, vectorization flag) so parallel projection workers no longer access `sessionctx.Context`; builder and related tests/benchmarks are updated accordingly.
